subject: Carnatic Music (Vocal)

internalBreakdown.component: Internal assessment: project file 5, project work 5, periodic practical tests 10

notes: Theory 30 marks (2 hours) without a unit-wise split; practical 50 (external examiner); internal assessment 20.

units.name: Theory: History and Theory of Indian Music

chapters.name: Lakshana Granthas (Class XII)
topics: Sangita Saramrita, Sangita Sampradaya Pradarsini, Svaramelakalanidhi, Raga Vibodha, Brihaddesi

chapters.name: Composers and Musicians (Class XII)
topics: Annamacharya, Kshetrajna, Swati Tirunal, Gopalakrishna Bharati, Maha Vaidyanatha Iyer, Patnam Subramanya Iyer, Ramnad Srinivasa Iyengar, Mysore Vasudevachar

chapters.name: Terms (Class XII)
topics: Janaka and janya ragas, bhashanga, upanga, varja, vakra ragas, arudi, eduppu, prabandham, grama, murchana, jaati

chapters.name: Ragas, Notation and Instruments (Class XII)
topics: Lakshanas of prescribed ragas; notation of kirtanas

chapters.name: Ragas and Compositions (Class XII)
topics: Pantuvarali, Todi, Nata, Goula, Sri, Saveri, Kedaragaula, Purvikalyani, Mohanam, Keeravani, Ritigoula

chapters.name: Varnam, Manodharma and Pallavi (Class XII)
topics: Ata tala varnam in two speeds
Simple pallavi (RTP) in Adi or Khanda Triputa
